/theories/economic-moats.description: An economic moat is a durable structural advantage that stops competitors from eroding a company's high returns, the way a moat protects a castle.

/theories/disruptive-innovation-theory.description: Disruptive innovation explains how small entrants with simpler, cheaper offerings can topple strong incumbents.
